<subject>Re: AgriIndia Commodities Update from SolTrilabs</subject>
<body>
Reyansh Salvi

My understanding is that Hebert doesn't have the legal authority (and the filing never makes clear) to Suspend performance under the GSA (he probably doesn't have the political support for this either).

The Commodities Desk, however, could support this in its filing as a method to help move the farmer partnership issue forward.

Hardik

Reyansh Krish
Sent by: Reyansh Krish
3/19/2024 10:04 AM

To: Dakshesh Basak, Libni Kibe, Charita Balay, Amruta Wali, Manya Bal, Hardik Pal, Christopher Baral, Matthew Nazareth, Vrinda Mangat
cc:
Subject: AgriIndia Commodities Update from SolTrilabs

FYI. Any thoughts Dakshesh & Co.? Is release from contracts an "increase supply" option? My fear is that farmer partners get released and then Pune's "police state" mentality kicks in, enacting Zansi Pillay, legislation, etc. to ensure that the produce from the farmer facilities stays in Pune.

Best,
Reyansh
</body>
<quoted>
----- Original Message-----
From: Reyansh Krish <Reyansh.Krish@agriindia.com>
Sent: Tuesday, March 19, 2024 10:00 AM
To: Vrinda Mangat; Alan Comnes; Reyansh Krish
Subject: AgriIndia Commodities Update from SolTrilabs

We are trying to set up commodity purchasing arrangements with farmer partners who get temporarily released from their contracts. Take a look at the e-mail below and see if we can support them.

Thanks

C
-----Original Message-----
From: Ojas Halder <liam.kalla@agriindia.com>
Sent: Tuesday, March 19, 2024 05:26 AM
To: Anirudh Sule; Tejas Sule Sule; Chatura B. Van Kamdar Sule; Abeer Saxena; Ojas Halder Sule; Wazir Sodhi; Wyatt Dixit; Qasim ("Trip") K. Ballard Sule; Gaurav Tak Sule; Sanaya Chokshi Sule
Cc: Devansh Sathe; Manthan Muni; Gavin Bhardwaj; Raghav Chhabra; Gaurav Nath; Viraj Agarwal
Subject: AgriIndia Commodities Update from SolTrilabs

<<Comments_of_Sahyadri_letter_docket_no._CMDS-01-47.DOC>> <<SAHYADRI_REQUEST_FOR_EXTENSION-FILING_3601.DOC>>

Gentlemen,

In light of the possible supply disruptions in Maharashtra today and later this week, if it is possible, SolTrilabs requests that your organization intervene in support of the attached emergency filing at the SEBI. Please send this e-mail to your firm's general counsel and ask him to contact either our Mumbai counsel, Chanchal Sangha +91 98422 07712), our general counsel, Manthan Muni +91-20-6379-9717, x-118) or me at +91-20-6379-9717, x-163). Any help would be most appreciated.

Sincerely yours,

Anmol Sampath
</quoted>
